subject: Fwd: Aug transport inv
body:
Hi team, forwarding the invoice from our accounts dept. Inv NS-4821 for USD 3,840 is attached for the August freight services. Pls process when possible.

Regards,
Meera
Accounts Payable

subject: Invoice CM-9017 - August cloud usage
body: Hello Finance, attached is our invoice CM-9017 for the August cloud hosting charges, total EUR 1,975. Please confirm once it has been logged.

subject: pls process invoice
body: Hi, pls find attached inv BD-7712 for office support services. Total amt INR 86,400. Let me know if anything else is required.

subject: September services - billing
body: Good morning. We are submitting the attached invoice VS-3308 for the software maintenance work completed last month. Amount due: $5,620. Thanks.

subject: Invoice attached / PO 77821
body: Hi Finance Team, invoice GF-1189 is attached against PO 77821. Kindly upload it into your system. The invoice total is USD 4,250.

subject: Re: printing charges
body: As discussed, sending the final bill for the brochures and banners delivered last week. Invoice RP-5510, total INR 42,750, is attached. Please process.

subject: Monthly invoice - security services
body: Dear Team, attached please find invoice ZS-6402 for September security monitoring services. Amount payable is $2,180. Kindly acknowledge receipt.

subject: FW: billing document
body: Forwarding the document we spoke about. It is invoice BW-2044 for the analytics project, 7,850 EUR. Sorry, forgot to send this yesterday.

subject: Inv no MO-9921
body: Please find attached our invoice MO-9921 for September facility management. Amount is INR 1,12,000. Pls log and process.

subject: September invoice - campaign services
body: Hi, submitting invoice OM-7301 for the September marketing campaign. Total $6,400. The supporting document is attached. Please confirm receipt.

subject: still waiting on INV-4418
body: Hi, just checking again on INV-4418. It was due last Friday and we still don't see the payment in our account. Any update from finance?

subject: Payment status pls
body: Hello, can you pls check status of invoice SL-2088? We were told payment was being processed but nothing has arrived yet.

subject: RE: invoice DS-774
body: Hi, following up on the below. Has payment for DS-774 been released? The due date passed 4 days ago. Please advise expected payment date.

subject: payment not received
body: We haven't received the payment for our September invoice. Could you check with your accounts team and let us know when it will be credited?

subject: Any update on payment?
body: Hi team, just wanted to see if PW-5530 has been approved and paid. We are reconciling our books and the amount isn't showing yet.

subject: INV-9811 - overdue
body: Good afternoon, invoice INV-9811 is now overdue. Can you confirm whether payment has been scheduled and share the expected settlement date?

subject: checking remittance
body: Can someone confirm if the remittance for NT-1207 went out? Our bank statement doesn't show it yet. Thanks.

subject: Payment ETA for invoice
body: Could you let us know when we should expect payment against the latest invoice? We need an ETA for our cash-flow planning.

subject: INV 6688 payment
body: Hi, any idea when invoice 6688 will be cleared? We submitted it last month and haven't heard anything.

subject: Payment confirmation required
body: Please confirm whether the payment for AE-4430 has been initiated. If already processed, kindly share the remittance reference.

subject: URGENT - wrong amount on invoice
body: Hi, this invoice shows $4,800 but our approved PO was only $3,800. Please review this immediately and correct the billing.

subject: Re: MS-771 billing
body: We need to dispute the additional $650 charge on MS-771. Those services were not requested by our team. Please investigate.

subject: charged twice
body: Hi, looks like we have been billed twice for the same installation. One charge is on 14 Sep and another on 15 Sep. Can you check and reverse the duplicate?

subject: Tax amount doesn't match
body: The tax on invoice OC-4401 is calculated at 18%, but our contract specifies 12%. We cannot approve the current amount. Please issue a corrected invoice.

subject: Dispute - unexpected service fee
body: We noticed a service fee of INR 7,500 that wasn't part of our agreement. Please explain this charge and remove it if it was added in error.

subject: This amount is not correct
body: Your latest bill is higher than what we agreed. Contract says $2,000/month but the invoice is for $2,750. Kindly investigate.

subject: Unrecognized charge on account
body: We don't recognize the $1,140 charge dated September 17. Nobody from our team authorized this. Please investigate the transaction.

subject: Incorrect line items in INV-882
body: Two items on INV-882 were never delivered, but we have been charged for them. Please remove those line items and send a revised invoice.

subject: Invoice discrepancy
body: Our PO total is EUR 9,200 while the invoice received is EUR 10,100. There is a difference we cannot reconcile. Please check.

subject: Not happy with latest billing
body: We were promised the old subscription rate, but the latest invoice uses the new price without notice. We want this charge reviewed and corrected.

subject: URGENT!!! YOU WON $2,000,000
body: Congratulations! Your email was selected for a cash prize. Send your bank account details and pay a small processing fee to release the funds.

subject: Invoice overdue - pay immediately
body: FINAL NOTICE. Your account will be suspended unless you pay within 2 hours. Open the attached payment link and enter your card information.

subject: Your Microsoft account will be closed
body: We detected unusual activity. Verify your password immediately using the link below or your account will be deleted today.

subject: 90% OFF - today only
body: Exclusive business offer! Buy software licenses at 90% discount. Click here now before the offer expires. No credit card? No problem!

subject: Payment required - INV-9988
body: Please urgently pay the attached invoice using the cryptocurrency wallet below. Failure to pay within 30 minutes will result in legal action.

subject: Double your money in 24 hours
body: Invest just $100 today and receive $10,000 tomorrow. Guaranteed returns. Send your wallet address to get started.

subject: Final prize notification
body: You have won an international shopping reward. To claim it, confirm your date of birth, bank details and a $25 verification fee.

subject: Action required: verify account
body: Your mailbox will be disabled today. Please click the verification link and enter your username and password to keep access.

subject: FREE GIFT FOR YOUR COMPANY
body: You have been selected for a free business gift. Confirm your payment card information to cover the $1 shipping fee.

subject: Urgent confidential payment
body: I am currently unavailable. Purchase five gift cards immediately and send me the codes. This is confidential and must be done now.

subject: Transaction question
body: Hi, can you check what is happening with our recent transaction? We need some clarification. Thanks.

subject: Re: account
body: Something seems off with our account. Can someone from finance have a look? I'm not sure exactly what changed.

subject: Please check this
body: We noticed something unusual in our recent financial activity. Could you review it and let us know?

subject: Need help with latest records
body: Hi team, our latest records don't look right. I can't tell if this is related to billing or payment. Please have someone check.

subject: Quick question
body: Could you take a look at our account and let us know if everything is okay? There is a number that doesn't look familiar.

subject: Recent transaction
body: There is something we would like you to check regarding a recent transaction. It might be an invoice issue, but we're not sure.

subject: Finance question
body: We have a question about something recently recorded on our account. Could someone review it? I don't have the reference number with me.

subject: pls review
body: Hi, pls check our latest account activity. Something seems different from before but I don't know what. Let me know.

subject: Issue with recent records
body: Our recent financial records don't seem correct. We are not sure whether a payment is missing or a charge is wrong. Could you investigate?

subject: Clarification needed
body: Could someone clarify the status of our recent account activity? We don't have enough information to understand what happened. Please advise.
